whatIsIt.eli5: Grades how close each guessed point is to the real point.
whatIsIt.simple: Based on Object Keypoint Similarity: the error of each point is scaled by the object size and by how hard that point is to place.
whatIsIt.engineer: 1 − exp(−d²/(2s²k²)) per keypoint with per-keypoint sigmas; gain pose = 12.0. YOLO26 adds RLE.

whyExists.eli5: Being a bit off on a big object matters less than on a tiny one.
whyExists.simple: Scale-aware errors make the loss fair for big and small objects.
